mapper.select: SELECT id, name, author, url, cover, lrc, create_time, update_time FROM blog_music ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, name, author, url, cover, lrc, create_time, update_time FROM blog_music WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_music (id, name, author, url, cover, lrc) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{author}, #{url}, #{cover}, #{lrc})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_music SET name = #{name}, author = #{author}, url = #{url}, cover = #{cover}, lrc = #{lrc} WHERE id = #{id}
